newsitem.title: FRANCE: Mobutu to leave hospital Thursday - spokesman.
newsitem.headline: Mobutu to leave hospital Thursday - spokesman.

text.p: Ailing Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko will leave hospital in Monaco on Thursday after follow-up treatment for his prostate cancer, a presidential spokesman said on Wednesday.
Airport officials said the president's private plane was standing by at Nice airport to take him back to his war-torn country but no date had been set for his return.

The spokesman gave no time for the 66-year-old Mobutu's release from the Princess Grace hospital, where he was admitted at the weekend after a month convalescing in his nearby mansion on the French Riviera from prostate surgery in Switzerland last August.
Mobutu's son Mobutu Nzanga has repeatedly said that his father aims to return soon to Zaire, where Tutsi rebels are sweeping across the east of the country.
Nice airport officials said Mobutu's white Boeing 727 and a cargo plane for his belongings arrived at the Riviera airport on Tuesday night.
